title: Apple unveils M5 MacBook Pro lineup starting at $1,599
content: Apple on Tuesday announced its next-generation M5 MacBook Pro lineup, featuring up to 3.5x faster neural processing for local AI models. The new machines start at $1,599 and will begin shipping next Friday across 30 countries.

title: Apple announces new M5 laptop line starting at $1,599
content: Apple revealed its refreshed MacBook Pro family featuring the M5 processor starting at $1,599, emphasizing on-device machine learning capabilities.

title: The new M5 MacBook Pro is here with major Neural Engine upgrades
content: Apple has officially taken the wraps off its M5 MacBook Pro, promising 3.5x faster neural processing and starting at $1,599.

title: Federal Reserve cuts benchmark interest rate by 50 basis points
content: The Federal Reserve lowered its key lending rate by half a percentage point to a range of 4.75% to 5.00%, launching an aggressive easing cycle amidst cooling inflation.

title: Fed lowers key lending rate by half a point in aggressive easing move
content: Federal Reserve policymakers delivered a 50 basis point interest rate cut today, bringing benchmark borrowing costs down to 4.75%-5.00%.

title: OpenAI rolls out SearchGPT integrated directly into ChatGPT
content: OpenAI announced today that SearchGPT is now built directly into ChatGPT, giving users real-time web search with links to publisher sources.

title: ChatGPT gets real-time web search capabilities in OpenAI update
content: ChatGPT can now search the web in real time, delivering timely answers with direct citations from journalism outlets.

title: SpaceX Starship rocket completes historic catch by mechanical arms
content: SpaceX pulled off an unprecedented engineering feat today, catching its Super Heavy booster mid-air using tower chopstick arms at Starbase Texas.

title: SpaceX catches returning Super Heavy booster with tower chopstick arms
content: During Flight 5, SpaceX successfully caught the returning 232-foot rocket booster as it decelerated precisely between the mechanical arms of the launch tower.

title: TSMC reports 54 percent jump in net profit fueled by AI chip demand
content: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co posted a 54% jump in third-quarter net profit, beating estimates as demand for AI hardware from Nvidia surged.

title: TSMC quarterly net income climbs 54% as Nvidia and Apple orders accelerate
content: TSMC reported revenue and earnings beats with quarterly net income surging 54% year-over-year, reaffirming high capital expenditure guidance.

title: Tesla third quarter profit surges as vehicle deliveries rebound
content: Tesla shares jumped 12% in extended trading after third-quarter profit beat Wall Street expectations, supported by lower cost per vehicle and energy storage growth.

title: Tesla Q3 net income tops expectations aided by automotive margin growth
content: Automaker Tesla reported expanding gross margins and net profit growth in the third quarter as global delivery volumes stabilized.

title: EU fines Meta 798 million euros over marketplace antitrust violations
content: The European Commission has imposed a 798 million euro penalty on Meta for abusing its dominant market position by tying Facebook Marketplace to Facebook.

title: European Commission slaps Meta with 798M euro penalty over classified ads
content: Brussels antitrust enforcers issued a 798 million euro fine against Meta Platforms today, ordering the company to end tying practices.

title: Boeing workers vote to accept contract offer ending seven-week strike
content: Machinists at Boeing voted 59% to approve a new contract providing a 38% wage hike, concluding a 53-day strike across Washington and Oregon.

title: Boeing machinists approve new union contract to conclude 53-day walkout
content: More than 33,000 Boeing machinists will return to assembly lines this week after approving a four-year collective bargaining agreement.

title: Reykjanes volcano erupts again on southwestern Iceland peninsula
content: A volcanic fissure opened near Grindavik on Wednesday, prompting civil protection officials to order defensive barricades closed.

title: James Webb Space Telescope detects water vapor on temperate rocky exoplanet
content: Astronomers analyzing transmission spectra from the James Webb Space Telescope have identified atmospheric water vapor signatures on a nearby exoplanet.
